ea251964916d35415a5aa71b831d64aa93613a32: Physical wire byte, node and depth accounting includes the envelope. Logical payload accounting counts the JSON payload once. Failure never truncates a value.
f0754e62859b0953a4383c51564fc3d8787ead2b: Use the selected target's pinned MoonBit core math ln primitive and canonical finite-result validation. General last-bit equality across native, WebAssembly, JavaScript, platform math libraries or live BigQuery is not asserted.
f097101e0f7d72ed3e65916aeb7172179d6ca3bc: actql-expression-fragment/0.1 self-CID excludes only fragment_cid. expression_contract_cid pins this contract. request binds source schemas, canonical source pipeline, typed parameter values and ceilings. graph has inline expression nodes at REL.derive /exprs/name, REL.where and REL.assert_all /expr, REL.groupBy /aggs/name/expr and optional /aggs/name/filter. Pointers are relative to params and RFC6901 escaped. Roots are ordered by graph step order then pointer code-unit order; each root stores source, node, checked contract and demand paths rooted at /roots/index/source. Aggregate arguments prepend their own filter-root true test. Admission recompiles request and requires exact equality of graph, root list, types and demand. Schema/self-CID alone is insufficient. Other consumers require a separately admitted binding contract; this revision does not grant them an implicit root position.
f3a85329b00cc2a46389c11eec753193c9050aba: Apply division of the first operand by the second with ordinary binary64 rounding. Return NULL for finite-input overflow or a zero divisor. Preserve finite results, including subnormals and underflow to zero, and normalize either zero sign to canonical positive zero. Either NULL operand produces NULL. The distinct legacy safe_div keeps its zero-divisor-only rule; it is not an alias of safe_divide.
f509345121fa8488287b70b53028cacee3ccba98: The closed source form is {safe_divide: [left, right]}; the closed machine node is {op: safe_divide, body: [left_node, right_node]}. Retain the operation and both ordered children in canonical lowering, including constant arguments. Earlier contract CIDs retain their earlier meanings.
f6b45cfa67ec301452253505fc28f4fc02eb2b05: The closed source forms are {ltrim: expression} and {ltrim: [value, characters]}; the machine node is {op: ltrim, body: expression_node} or {op: ltrim, body: [value_node, characters_node]} respectively. Preserve existing unary canonical bytes. Retain the authored operation and every ordered child, including empty, duplicate or reordered set expressions, even when the value is unchanged. Earlier expression and scalar-law contract CIDs retain their earlier meanings and do not acquire the explicit-set overload.
fa37ff8a33c6211da870b1a0b6525106eee277f4: Return the greatest operand in the existing finite numeric order. Any NULL operand produces NULL, including a singleton NULL. A non-null singleton returns itself. Equal values and repeated operands preserve their value; zero uses the existing canonical positive zero. No arithmetic overflow, precision reduction or non-finite result is introduced.
fc621a419bd7f83afdaa44947286c86d00955769: The closed source form is {ln: expression}; the machine node is {op: ln, body: expression_node}. SQL LN(x) and LOG(x), and expression-text ln(x) and log(x), normalize to this same unary operation. Retain the operation and child, including constants. Earlier contract CIDs retain their earlier meanings.
ff84f45f002af6f0d1c501a91d70a337cc877245: Return exactly -1 for a negative finite number, canonical positive zero for either zero sign, and exactly 1 for a positive finite number. This includes subnormal and largest finite magnitudes. NULL produces NULL.
